scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix tools/e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run dep:check && npm run build
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run e2e
